sanskrit_verse:
अब्रुवन् हि नरः साक्ष्यम् ऋणं सदशबन्धकम् ।
राज्ञा सर्वं प्रदाप्यः स्यात् षट्चत्वारिंशकेऽहनि ॥७६॥
transliteration: abruvan hi naraḥ sākṣyam ṛṇaṃ sadaśabandhakam / rājñā sarvaṃ pradāpyaḥ syāt ṣaṭcatvāriṃśake 'hani // YajñS_2.76
sph_interpretive_translation: When a person speaks falsely as a witness in a debt-related matter that binds the assembly, all possessions shall be surrendered to the King by the forty-sixth day.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the King to restore alignment through material surrender
Causation arises from false speech disrupting collective dharmic order
Capacity-based responsibility is tied to presence within the sabhā and invocation of testimony
Restoration logic demands return of misaligned resources to sovereign oversight
Consciousness alignment requires purification through enforced transparency
executable_legal_axioms: IF a witness gives false testimony in a debt case linked to sabhā THEN all assets MUST be transferred to the ruling authority by day 46
IF testimony disrupts financial dharma THEN automatic seizure protocol activates under royal supervision
IF individual fails voluntary compliance THEN asset liquidation initiates without punitive intent
IF falsehood impacts communal bond THEN full restitution executed via administrative surrender
IF consciousness distortion detected THEN public disclosure mandated until alignment restored
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, this verse establishes that perjury affecting economic-social harmony triggers immediate state intervention. The threshold for responsibility lies in intentional disruption of dharma-vākya within institutional contexts. Authority flows unilaterally from the sovereign to ensure systemic realignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies false witness as root cause of resource disorder. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through sequential loss of credibility, followed by asset transfer, culminating in societal reintegration. Proportional responsibility aligns with scope of harm; non-punitive execution ensures correction without infliction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Full disclosure of assets and debts within 30 days
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Public acknowledgment before sabhā elders
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Mandatory truth-speaking training until verified
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Graduated return of social standing post-alignment confirmation
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma prevails through conscious rectification, not punishment. All actions originate from and return to the Source. Reality itself adjudicates through alignment.
